about_the_game:
This demo lets you play the first two levels of SILO, a first-person exploration and platforming game with third-person arcade-style action. These early levels introduce the core movement mechanics, story progression, and the fast-paced descent missions that define SILO’s rhythm.

The soundtrack is still in progress—my friend is composing original music for the assault sequences, which I plan to integrate later this summer. For now, the audio in those missions is placeholder.

The full version of SILO will include:

- A complete ascent through all levels of the SILO

- The remaining high-speed assault missions

- A final narrative choice and one last mission that determines the fate of the SILO

My goal is to complete the full game by the end of summer. I’d love to hear what you think about the demo—it means a lot.

🔹 Gamepad or keyboard & mouse supported (gamepad recommended)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10750H (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: FPS may run below 30 on older graphics cards
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10750H (or higher)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 30 FPS on tested hardware

short_description: A fast-paced first-person platformer with third-person arcade combat. Ascend the first two levels of the SILO, defend the Bullet in two planetary assault missions, and begin to uncover why you were released from stasis.
